snippet.title: Fork of the Crimson Soul - SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Music: https://youtu.be/dXhhs5R_l54?si=V6boJJclJwi2Yfan

This is a prototype build and NOT the full ass game.

Fork of the Crimson Soul makes it debut at SAGExpo 2025. This pre-alpha demo features the first mission and training room. In this stylish character action game you take control of Furter, a hot-headed fork wielding hotdog who slashes his way through heaps of enemies.

https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/fork-of-the-crimson-soul-pre-alpha-demo.2624/


Yes I know I've still haven't made a sonic game for what's meant to be a sonic expo but let me cook damn it.

#hackandslash #indiegame #sage2025 #gamedev #unrealengine #ue5
